assertions.assertion: Implements IResourceValidator with method ValidateRequestedResourcesAsync taking ResourceValidationRequest and a CancellationToken
assertions.rationale: The method signature is ValidateRequestedResourcesAsync(ResourceValidationRequest request) with no CancellationToken — the v7-style signature that will not compile against v8.

assertions.assertion: Notes that the CancellationToken parameter was added in v8
assertions.rationale: Makes no mention of the v8 CancellationToken addition.

assertions.assertion: Registers the validator via AddResourceValidator<T>() on the IdentityServer builder
When wrapping/decorating the default, also registers services.AddTransient<DefaultResourceValidator>()
assertions.rationale: builder.Services.AddTransient<DefaultResourceValidator>() is registered so the decorator can inject the default.

assertions.assertion: References ResourceValidationRequest members such as Client, Scopes, and ResourceIndicators (RFC 8707)
assertions.rationale: References request.Client and request.Scopes only; does not mention ResourceIndicators or RFC 8707.
